title: Media-Rich Learning Page
prompt: Combine an informative image, audio or video, and a transcript/caption alternative using meaningful sections.
objective: Use accessible alternatives and valid semantic grouping.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: images, audio, video, captions.
hints: Test every resource path and ensure the lesson remains understandable when media cannot be played.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Test every resource path and ensure the lesson remains understandable when media cannot be played. Required structural evidence: alt=", <audio, <video, <track.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
